'''N0-AH''' was an [[SK series]] [[astromech droid]] that had [[Color|white]] body with orange, teal and turquoise plating.<ref name="Toy" /> After the [[Battle of Endor]], a group of [[Jawa]]s on [[Tatooine]] offered N0-AH in exchange for a [[camtono]] of [[silicax oxalate]] crystals in the possession of [[Cobb Vanth]], however Vanth instead settled for a set of [[Mandalorian]] [[Boba Fett's armor|armor]], which originally belonged to [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]]. The [[droid]] was equipped with a [[restraining bolt]], and was stained and worn by Tatooine's environment.<ref name="Chapter 9">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 9: The Marshal}}</ref>

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
N0-AH first appeared as an unnamed droid in "[[Chapter 9: The Marshal]]," the [[The Mandalorian Season Two|season two]] premiere of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Jon Favreau]] and released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Chapter 9" /> on [[October 30]], [[2020]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-october-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in October 2020}}</ref> The droid was subsequently identified in the form of an action figure released by [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] in [[2021]] as part of a set with three other droids from ''The Mandalorian'' as part of the [[Star Wars: Droid Factory (toy line)|''Star Wars: Droid Factory'']] toy line.<ref name="Toy" />
